_doc: Liste machine des visuels à générer (miroir de design/stitch_images/A_FOURNIR.md). trial = essai de 10 images validé par Simo avant le reste. subject = description en anglais envoyée au modèle.

ingredient.prompt: Professional studio product photograph of {subject}. A single subject, centered, isolated on a pure white background (#FFFFFF) that fills the whole frame edge to edge. Soft diffused natural light from the top left, a subtle soft contact shadow under the subject, sharp focus, realistic textures, fresh and appetizing. Generous empty margin around the subject. No packaging brand, no label, no text, no logo, no props, no hands.

theme.prompt: Bright editorial food photograph: {subject}. Light and airy modern kitchen setting, soft natural daylight, fresh and appetizing, gentle pastel green and warm neutral tones, tight square framing on the subject, shallow depth of field. No people, no hands, no text, no logos, no brand labels on any packaging.

recipe.prompt: Appetizing editorial food photograph of {subject}, served on a matte ceramic plate on a light oak wooden table, three-quarter view, soft natural window daylight, a few fresh herbs as garnish, shallow depth of field, clean premium style inspired by modern French cookbooks. No text, no logo, no hands, no people.

decor.prompt: Photorealistic {subject}, isolated on a fully transparent background, soft natural light, crisp edges, no shadow on the background, no text.

illustration.prompt: Bright editorial lifestyle photograph: {subject}. Soft natural daylight, modern clean kitchen, gentle pastel green and warm neutral tones, shallow depth of field, premium magazine style. No text anywhere, no user interface on the phone screen, no icons, no logos, no brand labels.

portrait.prompt: Editorial lifestyle photograph, portrait 4:5 orientation: {subject}. Natural window light, bright modern kitchen or dining room, calm and premium mood, shallow depth of field, gentle warm and soft green tones. No text, no logos, no brand labels.

scene.prompt: Warm editorial lifestyle photograph: {subject}. Natural window light, cozy modern French home dining setting, soft warm tones, three-quarter view, shallow depth of field, premium magazine style. No text, no logos, no brand labels.
